# LiteraryWorm - Ebooks and Audiobooks for the Whole Household

> LiteraryWorm is a reading and listening app: ebooks and audiobooks in one library, with a profile for each person at home (Kids and Teen profiles see only titles rated for them). It runs in any modern browser and installs as an app. Members pay monthly or yearly through Stripe and can cancel online at any time.

LiteraryWorm's full-text and audio library is public-domain classics: texts from Project Gutenberg and LibriVox recordings, including titles in French, German and Spanish. Members can also find almost any book through Google Books, keep it in their library, and upload their own DRM-free EPUBs (up to 20 at a time, each up to 50 MB), such as books they bought elsewhere, to read with their place, highlights and notes.

## Main Features

- **Reader and player**: highlights in twelve colours, notes, bookmarks, a dictionary, OpenDyslexic, a reading ruler and line focus; an audiobook player with a mini-player, a read-along transcript (for eight classics, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, Through the Looking-Glass, Frankenstein, Pride and Prejudice, A Christmas Carol, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde and The Call of the Wild, the book's own text marked as the LibriVox reader says it), sleep timer, car mode (big buttons that fill a phone or tablet screen, and voice control), Cast and listening on another device.
- **Household profiles**: up to 12 profiles (by plan), each with its own library, lists, goals, streaks and stats; PIN locks, daily limits and bedtimes; Kids profiles ask a grown-up for other books.
- **Book clubs**: spoiler-free discussion by chapter, AI discussion questions on the classics, polls on what to read next, meetings with calendar files, shared highlights, listening along and where everyone is in the book. A club can read a LiteraryWorm title or a book its owner uploaded, found by title, author, ISBN or keywords and sorted by title, author, numbers or series; uploads stay private, and each member reads their own copy.
- **Reading tools**: Didn't finish and Read again, moods and pace (with Feel-good picks on Discover), goals with rest days, reading plans to finish by a date, word and highlight review, badges, a Year in Review, imports and exports for Goodreads and StoryGraph, offline reading and scheduled offline listening.
- **AI help, labelled as AI**: book summaries, content notes, Ask the book, Translate, Who's who, Previously… recaps and book clubs' discussion questions written by Claude (Anthropic), never past the reader's place.
- **Browse**: 64 genres (Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Classics, Poetry and LGBTQIA+ among them, plus every top-level Google Books subject, such as Cooking, Comics & Graphic Novels, Philosophy, Travel and True Crime, each showing only books filed under that subject) on Home, Discover and Search, with a row each for the brief's six and a profile's favourites. Visitors see a sample of 20 books on the home page; logged in, Keep discovering scrolls on through every genre. On adult profiles, Home's rows come from Open Library first, with Google Books as the fallback.
- **Search**: by title, author, keywords (descriptions, genres and series too) or ISBN, with keyword searches to try on Discover and Search. Members' own DRM-free EPUB uploads can be searched by title, author, keywords or ISBN, even inside their text, on their device. An upload can be listened to as well as read, with a voice from the member's own device, a natural voice from Google (within a monthly allowance by plan: Basic 2 hours, Standard 6, Premium 12), or the LibriVox recording, read by a person, when the catalog has the same public-domain book.
- **Sharing**: gift wishlists (a shared list can be given as a gift membership with its books), invite a friend (you each get a month free after their first payment, up to 2 months for inviting), reading sprints (a timed 15–30 minute session for a household or a book club, with everyone's pages at the end), buddy reads (a club for two) and links to short clips of public-domain LibriVox recordings.
- **Languages and access**: the app in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian and Dutch (chosen in the accessibility menu, starting in the browser's language; the policies stay in English), with high contrast, larger text, Lexend or OpenDyslexic for the whole app, and reduced motion; the menu scrolls on small screens.

## Pricing Information

- **[LiteraryWorm - Plans](https://www.literaryworm.com/plans)**: prices in US dollars, plus any applicable tax. A year costs ten months.
  - Basic: $15.00/month or $150.00/year (1 profile, 5 hours of audiobooks a month, offline on 1 device)
  - Standard: $20.00/month or $200.00/year (up to 3 profiles, 30 hours a month, offline on 10 devices)
  - Premium: $30.00/month or $300.00/year (up to 12 profiles, unlimited audiobooks, offline on 24 devices)
- Gift memberships of 1, 3, 6 or 12 months, with up to 10 books to start with.
- **Affiliate program** (/affiliates): approved members earn 20% of a referred member's first payment as account credit (no cash payouts), must disclose the commission and never market to children.
- **Try the demo** on the log-in page: a sample household kept in memory (books, clubs, a reading sprint, reading lists, highlights, a sample reader to follow, a reminder for a sample upcoming book, an invite link and a wishlist to give), which can't take payments.

- **[Privacy Policy](https://www.literaryworm.com/legal/privacy)** and **[Terms of Service](https://www.literaryworm.com/legal/terms)**. No advertising; visits are counted with Ahrefs Web Analytics (no cookies) only when a visitor allows analytics, and never for Kids profiles.
